narrative.summary: One regional AI instrument has been identified so far: the Guiding Manual on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2025), an advisory manual prepared by GCC ministerial and judicial committees and published by the GCC Secretariat General. Bahrain has announced its adoption; adoption by other Member States has not been confirmed.
narrative.review_notes: The GCC Secretariat General digital library and Bahrain's Information & eGovernment Authority were checked. National adoption of the regional ethics manual is recorded only where a Member State has announced it.

instruments.english_title: Guiding Manual on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
instruments.issuing_authority: GCC Ministerial Committee for eGovernment and Committee of Presidents of Supreme and Cassation Courts (joint work); published by the GCC Secretariat General
instruments.current_status: Published by the GCC Secretariat General in 2025 as a guiding (advisory) manual. Bahrain's Information & eGovernment Authority announced its adoption on 27 July 2025.
instruments.scope: Ethical use of artificial intelligence by users of the technology in GCC Member States, including government and judicial work.
instruments.summary: Guiding manual on the ethical use of artificial intelligence, prepared jointly by the GCC committee of heads of supreme and cassation courts and the Ministerial Committee for eGovernment and published by the GCC Secretariat General. It is advisory and is intended as a reference for all users of AI in Member States. Bahrain announced its adoption in July 2025.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Primary-source material for assessing responsible ai & ethics, regional & international.

instruments.evidence_reference: Arabic PDF on gcc-sg.org read 2026-10-18: cover and cataloguing data print 'الأمانة العامة 2025م', Riyadh, 24 pp., GCC publications number 0663-093/ح/ك/2025م; foreword states the manual is joint work of the committee of heads of supreme and cassation courts and the Ministerial Committee for eGovernment; title 'الدليل الاسترشادي' (guiding manual), advisory in nature. Bahrain adoption: iGA news 'Bahrain Launches National AI Policy and Adopts GCC Ethics Manual', 27 Jul 2025 (https://www.iga.gov.bh/en/article/bahrain-launches-national-ai-policy-and-adopts-gcc-ethics-manual), which names the issuer as the Ministerial Committee for eGovernment of the GCC.

coverage_audit.technical_note:
Gulf benchmark 2026-10-18: Guiding Manual record i-0821698b707b completed from the Arabic PDF on gcc-sg.org (cover prints year 2025 only; no day or month found, so publication_date is year-only); issuer set from the foreword (joint work of the committee of heads of supreme and cassation courts and the Ministerial Committee for eGovernment, published by the Secretariat General); legal_status nonbinding_guidance (title 'guiding manual', advisory wording, no binding clause). Bahrain adoption taken from the iGA news page dated 27 Jul 2025 (iga.gov.bh). No separate gcc-sg.org landing page for the PDF was located. Other GCC AI documents not searched exhaustively.

Catch-up sweep 2026-10-19 (window from 2026-10-06): checked GCC Secretariat homepage news list (gcc-sg.org, items 13-19 Oct 2026), GSO news (Oct 2026 items: ISO Annual Meeting, Made in the Gulf, ISO 9001 Arabic edition) and the GSO standards store search endpoint (gso.org.sa/store/standards-search) for 'companion', 'chatbot', 'social robot', 'artificial intelligence' and the Arabic term for AI, current and all editions. Found nothing new. Ruled out: claim of a 'GSO harmonised standard' on AI companion devices - not found in official sources (checked: gso.org.sa standards store incl. Gulf Technical Regulations and historical editions, GSO news, gcc-sg.org). GSO AI items are adoptions of ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42 standards (e.g. GSO ISO/IEC 22989:2024, 42001:2025, 23894:2025, 5339:2025); none concerns companion devices. 'Harmonised standard' is EU terminology; the only harmonised AI standard published in the window is EU EN 18286:2026 (OJ 14.10.2026), recorded in EU.json. Not reached: a GSO draft-standards public-comment listing (no public page located); gcc-sg.org news archive URL returned 404.
